result_text:
The warehouse stock list no longer shows products with zero stock. The fix is one condition in `listStockLevelsInWarehouse` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`: the query now has `AND s.quantity > 0`, the same filter the other stock overviews use.

I didn't add a test for the WH-1 example. The four stock test classes I ran (`StockOverviewTest`, `StockTest`, `DashboardTest`, `StockAdjustmentTest`) all pass. The quantity lookup for a single product is a separate query and is unchanged, so asking for nuts in WH-1 still returns 0.

Nothing is committed.
